attributes.check1: Intelligence or Perception or Charisma or Diplomacy 15
attributes.name: Eshen Theba
attributes.powers:
After you act, you are dealt 1 Mental damage that may not be reduced.

If Eshen Theba would be defeated, search your location deck for a monster; if you find one, Eshen Theba is undefeated. Otherwise, if Eshen Theba would be cornered, succeed at a Combat 23 check or each character at your location is dealt 1d6 Poison damage and Eshen Theba is undefeated.
